name: Prediabetes and insulin resistance
surveyQuestion: Do you have any of these health conditions? (select all that apply) -> Prediabetes / borderline sugar / insulin resistance. waterMl.notes: No change from FitPlate general water target. Prefer plain water, unsweetened buttermilk, lemon water or unsweetened tea/coffee; juice, sugarcane juice, sweet lassi and soft drinks do not count. Strong unusual thirst or frequent urination may signal diabetes: see a doctor rather than just drinking more.

warnings: General information, not medical advice. FitPlate does not diagnose prediabetes, insulin resistance or diabetes; only a blood test reviewed by a doctor can.
Medicines, including metformin, are a doctor's decision only. The app never suggests starting, stopping or changing a medicine or dose.
Strong unusual thirst, passing urine often, weight loss without trying or blurred vision can be signs of diabetes: see a doctor soon.

Lab values in the diabetes range (HbA1c 6.5% or more, fasting glucose 126 mg/dL or more, 2-h glucose 200 mg/dL or more) need a doctor to confirm; the app offers the Type 2 diabetes profile but does not switch it on by itself.
requires_doctor_input becomes true if the user is pregnant, under 18, has kidney disease, or takes insulin or a sulfonylurea.
Cut-offs differ between guidelines (ADA/RSSDI fasting 100-125 mg/dL vs WHO/ICMR 110-125 mg/dL; HbA1c 5.7-6.4% vs 6.0-6.4%); the user's lab or doctor may use different ranges.
HOMA-IR has no agreed cut-off; the app stores it but does not interpret it.
Re-test at least once a year (ADA; NICE PH38).
If on metformin long term, ask the doctor about vitamin B12 testing.
